title: His sister Katie and the relatives in the country
summary: His sister is Katie Bryant; relatives were his mother's sisters, such as Aunt Elsie, and his Harrington grandmother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Your sister's name again was what?
Katie Bryant.

Katie. Yeah. Uh huh. And...oh, you talked about goin' out into the country to visit your kinfolk in the summertime when you were livin' in Kansas City, and you told me off the tape that that was about a hundred miles out in the country, right?
Yeah.
A hundred miles from Kansas City. In which direction? From Kansas City?
They was livin' in a little ol' town called... Siskabub (?) or somethin'.
Hmmmmm. And what relatives were they? I mean, who...
It was my mother's sister.
Oh.
My mother had about seven sisters. And my grandmother's name was Harrington.
Remember her first name?
No. All I ever called her was Grandmomma.
Reel 4
That's a good name. And so you visited with... you went out...you visited in the country...and her kids. You said that...
Yeah, I visited her.
And you said she had all boys...and one girl... was that it?
Yeah, she had about seventeen children.
Mmmmmn. What was your aunt's name?
Aunt Elsie.
Aunt Elsie. Mmmmmn hmmmm...
Got so many of 'em can't remember 'em names.
